rationale: Local Three BatchedMesh computes per-geometry indexed-position bounds, transforms them using each instance's current matrix every render and respects existing visible/active mask. Parent whole-batch frustum culling stays disabled, preventing stale global bounds from hiding moved native ruins.
claimBoundary: At most about11% of reported full triangle count even if every street triangle is culled; actual gain is smaller and camera-dependent. Does not resolve or establish the cause of severe Lowest-setting lag.
